# Travada Books

> Travada Books is invoicing and bookkeeping software built in Nairobi for freelancers, consultants, agencies, and small businesses in Kenya.

Travada Books helps business owners automate recurring invoices, schedule invoice delivery, send overdue reminders, convert accepted quotes into invoices, import bank and M-Pesa statements from CSV or PDF, categorise transactions, match receipts from Gmail or Outlook, and keep documents in a searchable vault.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://travadabooks.com/): Product overview and common questions
- [Invoicing](https://travadabooks.com/invoicing): Recurring invoices, scheduled sending, reminders, quotes, and multi-currency billing
- [Statement import](https://travadabooks.com/statement-import): Bank and M-Pesa CSV/PDF import, categorisation, bulk actions, and export
- [Inbox](https://travadabooks.com/inbox): Gmail and Outlook receipt ingestion, transaction matching, and document storage
- [Integrations](https://travadabooks.com/integrations): Available Gmail and Outlook connections, plus the M-Pesa, Stripe, and WhatsApp roadmap
- [Who it is for](https://travadabooks.com/who-its-for): Use cases for freelancers, consultants, agencies, and small businesses
- [About](https://travadabooks.com/about): The Travada Books story and Nairobi context
- [Guides](https://travadabooks.com/guides): Practical invoicing and bookkeeping guidance
- [Updates](https://travadabooks.com/updates): Product changes and announcements

## Key facts

- Primary market: Kenya
- Base currency context: Kenyan shillings (KES)
- Supported invoice currencies include KES and foreign currencies
- Statement sources include banks and M-Pesa
- Import formats: CSV and PDF
- Connected email providers: Gmail and Outlook
- Planned integrations: M-Pesa, Stripe, and WhatsApp
- Intended users: freelancers, consultants, agencies, and small business owners
- Availability: web application
- Contact: info@travadabooks.com

## Canonical identity

- Name: Travada Books
- Company: Travada Systems
- Website: https://travadabooks.com/
- Location: Nairobi, Kenya
